«Разрыв в 100 000 лет» — точная мера тог: Is the “100,000-year data gap” an exact measure of how much less robot data there is than text?
Да, её посчитали по всем датасетам: Yes, it was computed over all the datasets
Нет: это мысленный эксперимент, перевод: No: it's a thought experiment that converts the corpus into reading time; the assumptions change the answer severalfold, but the order of magnitude stays
Нет: разрыв на самом деле около 100 лет: No: the gap is actually about 100 years
Кевин Блэк сам назвал своё сравнение нес: Kevin Black himself called his comparison a silly thought experiment, and Goldberg cited it in his column. Reading speed, tokens per word, whether images count: each assumption shifts the number, but not by five orders of magnitude.
Если записать вдвое больше демонстраций: If you record twice as many demonstrations in the same setting, will success in new settings double?
Да, если демонстрации аккуратные: Yes, if the demonstrations are clean
Нет: после небольшого порога демонстраци: No: past a small threshold, demonstrations in the same setting almost stop helping
Нет: он упадёт из-за переобучения: No: it will drop because of overfitting
У Lin и соавторов кривые для половины и: In Lin et al.'s experiments, the curves for half and for all of the demonstrations almost coincide. In the lab, twice as many demonstrations in one scene didn't change success, while a second scene raised it more than one and a half times.
Значит, демонстрации на обстановку вообщ: So demonstrations per setting don't matter at all, and all you need is new settings?
Нет: ниже порога демонстрации нужны; с о: No: below the threshold, demonstrations are needed; with one demonstration per scene, a second one helps as much as new scenes
Нет: демонстрации важнее обстановок: No: demonstrations matter more than settings
Порог зависит от задачи: у Lin и соавтор: The threshold depends on the task: in Lin et al.'s experiments, it's about 50 per environment–object pair. It pays to keep the demonstrations per setting at the threshold and spend the rest on diversity.
Что у Lin и соавторов убывает по степенн: What falls as a power law in Lin et al.'s experiments?
Число демонстраций, нужное для задачи: The number of demonstrations a task needs
Разрыв до оптимума — единица минус балл: The optimality gap, one minus the score on new environments and objects, as a function of the number of environments, objects or their pairs
В логарифмических осях это прямая: каждо: On logarithmic axes, it's a straight line: each doubling of the number of environments multiplies the gap by the same number. There's no such dependence on the total number of demonstrations: r is only −0.62 and −0.79.
Степенной закон значит, что успех будет: Does a power law mean that success will grow without limit as you add environments?
Да, прямая в логарифмических осях не кон: Yes, a straight line on logarithmic axes never ends
Нет: у задачи есть неустранимая доля про: No: the task has an irreducible failure rate, and the line was drawn through six points; the authors left the forecast of 1,191 pairs unverified
Нет, закон работает только до 8 сред: No, the law only holds up to 8 environments
Модель с третьим параметром, пределом, а: The authors didn't fit a model with a third parameter, the floor: with six points, it isn't justified. The further a forecast is from the data, the less you can trust it.
270 тысяч часов GEN-0 — это 270 тысяч ча: Are GEN-0's 270,000 hours 270,000 hours of robot work?
Да, это крупнейший парк роботов: Yes, it's the largest robot fleet
Нет: данные собирают тысячи устройств сб: No: the data is collected by thousands of collection devices and robots, and GEN-1's base model was trained without any robot data at all
Нет, это часы симуляции: No, those are hours of simulation
Generalist AI пишет о сети из тысяч устр: Generalist AI writes about a network of thousands of collection devices and robots. For GEN-1, with half a million hours, it says plainly that the recordings were made with wearable devices on people.
Ошибка действий на проверочных демонстра: Does the action error on validation demonstrations show how the robot will behave?
Нет: у Lin и соавторов она часто не совп: No: in Lin et al.'s experiments, it often didn't match the behavior on the robot, so they evaluated with a tester's score on real trials
Да, если демонстраций больше тысячи: Yes, if there are more than a thousand demonstrations
Средний квадрат ошибки действий подчиняе: The mean squared action error follows a similar law, but more weakly and with outliers. The robot acts in a closed loop, and a small error early on can take it where there are no demonstrations.
Чтобы политика лучше обобщала, достаточн: Is making the network bigger enough for the policy to generalize better?
Нет: у Lin и соавторов рост энкодера кар: No: in Lin et al.'s experiments, a larger image encoder helped but a larger action network didn't; for GEN-0, models smaller than 7B parameters “ossify” on large data
Нет: размер модели не влияет вовсе: No: model size has no effect at all
ViT-S, B и L дали баллы 0,66, 0,81 и 0,9: ViT-S, B and L scored 0.66, 0.81 and 0.90, while the large U-Net scored 0.83 versus 0.90 for the base one. Data and model size have to grow together.
